Prior rulings read: `docs/adr/0067` D3 (revertCommit restores "atomically" and answers honestly) and its 2026-11 "What the doors do" status paragraph, which describes today's behaviour: "the registry write-through … and the projector catch their own faults and log them, and their results are not read". PR #33805 already moved the object limb away from that description (review 6893528798 read it as status, not a ruling, keeping D3's promise); the status-line amendment is owed as #33850. No ⛔ line on write-through faults. No test pins the logged-only outcome as a requirement beyond the ones #33805 flipped. The order fences save/publish to today's answers, so no door's visible behaviour moves beyond the card's own "Wanted"; if that fence cannot hold the dev stops and the decision goes to the seat.
